reason: v11 accepted A-D but E made overlapping solid parts, a negative local coordinate and then one remaining floor/mat overlap across its three attempts. This diagnostic adds opt-in minimal-design/non-overlap guidance and reports all overlap pairs (up to 12) in a single validation error. Stage attempts rise from 3 to 4 and total calls from 14 to 16, but the 100000 locally accounted-token and 900 s limits remain. No geometric rule is weakened.
scope: One 0.1.0 fixed A-F single-storey building case, not general scene validation.
sample_policy: One run; all started calls count. Preserve v1-v11 records. Register any later live retry separately.

success.machine: result.json succeeds, source geometry validates, WIR package round-trips, Unity GLB and Minecraft schematic are produced from the same revision, and exact offline replay reproduces package and target hashes.
success.human: Inspect one single-storey timber house, street-facing connected entry and reachable room. Actual Unity/Minecraft import and walking require separate evidence.
success.report: Record calls, repairs, failures, elapsed time and provider usage. One pass is not general reliability evidence.
